title: 黄仁勋真正角色：首席供应链官被低估，没人能填补他的位置
speaker: Edward Chan

segments.en: I mean, there was really an underappreciated role that, you know, if you think about it, he was the chief supply chain officer.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，他作为首席供应链官的角色确实被低估了。

segments.en: He made sure that they had the capacity and they gave the capacity to the company.
segments.zh: 他确保了产能，并将产能提供给公司。

segments.en: How does that change the notion of NVIDIA's mode now, whether that's product development, the fundamentals, or simply the supply chain?
segments.zh: 这如何改变英伟达的模式，无论是产品开发、基本面还是供应链？

segments.en: Yeah. Yeah, I think that changed everything. Right.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这改变了一切。

segments.en: I think it's hard. Imagine, you know, someone who's able to fill in his shoes, given that how hands on he was on the company's management, and I think the supply chain management element of
segments.zh: 很难想象有人能填补他的位置，考虑到他对公司管理的亲力亲为，以及供应链管理要素
他的工作中，供应链管理部分显然被低估了。

segments.en: What have you been doing with your exposure to NVIDIA? Yeah.
segments.zh: 你对英伟达的敞口是怎么处理的？

segments.en: Yeah, so I'm pretty neutral on NVIDIA at this point.
segments.zh: 目前我对英伟达持中性态度。

segments.en: I think there's still a lot of uncertainty on the leadership, right, ultimately whether Genshin returns or not.
segments.zh: 我认为领导层仍有很多不确定性，最终取决于他是否回归。

segments.en: And so I think for a longer term, you know, if there's no clear side of him returning, I think it would be a difficult thesis to carry on.
segments.zh: 所以长期来看，如果没有他回归的明确迹象，这个论点将难以维持。
